data.body:
AC amendment (gap G2): Pin follow_on field placement + manifest serialization rule. inbound_repair_property returns outcome dict shape:
```python
{'status': 'ok' | 'repair_property_failed', 'key': mutation.target, 'follow_on': {...} | None}
```
follow_on is at the TOP LEVEL of the outcome dict (NOT nested under 'result'). MANIFEST CANONICAL-FORM EXCLUSION: when reconcile.py serializes the manifest, follow_on fields MUST be excluded from the canonical-form JSON used for cde1's byte-identical hash. Add an explicit unit test asserting that two manifests differing ONLY in follow_on field contents produce identical canonical-form hashes.
